body.message:
We would like to inform you that I have shared the Peninsula link, as Urban Oasis Building does not allow self-check-in. Since you will be arriving at 1:00 AM, an additional after-hours check-in fee will apply.

However, if you are comfortable with checking in after 3:00 PM on 28 August, we would be happy to assist you with the booking and provide you with the details for the Urban Oasis unit.
